decision: Deletion of lap time (1:30.573) as per Article 12.3.1.d of the FIA International Sporting Code and Art 31.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
event_name: Aston Martin Red Bull Racing Document 31 Date 22 June 2019 Time 17:05 2019 FRENCH GRAND PRIX 20 - 23 June 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 33 did not use the track at all times, and was deemed to have gained a lasting advantage.
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Ch IV, Art 2c and Article 31.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Deletion of lap time (1:30.573) as per Article 12.3.1.d of the FIA International Sporting Code and Art 31.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video and received timing information from the Race Director. The car left the track during Qualifying practice and set a fast time.
rules_referenced: Article 31.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 33 Track Limits
